title: Yellow Buttery Middle Eastern Chickpeas Hummus
description: A rich and creamy hummus dish featuring pecorino and dashi extract, perfect for a date night, this recipe is raw friendly and made with buttery and fluffy chickpeas.
instructions: In a blender or food processor, combine the chickpeas, pecorino cheese, dashi extract, lemon juice, garlic, and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Blend the mixture on high speed for about 2 minutes, or until smooth and creamy.
With the blender or food processor running, slowly pour in the olive oil and melted butter.
Continue blending for another minute, or until the hummus is light and fluffy.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Transfer the hummus to a serving bowl and garnish with a sprinkle of paprika.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional pecorino cheese if desired.
Cover and refrigerate any leftovers for up to 3 days.
